item.tib: rma sras dang shar gnyan dkar ba mdung rtse dang tsong ka'i mtsho sman gsum gyi zhu lan
item.coloph: de ltar rmi lam 'khrul snang 'di/ dkar chag yi ger btab pa yang / rig 'dzin rnams la mthol lo bshags/ 'di bris dge ba'i mthu dpal can/ bdag sogs sems can thams cad kun/ theg chen don dam mthar rdzogs te/ bon nyid dbu mar ye rdzogs nas/ mtha' 'khob bod kyi sa gnas 'dir/ 'phrul ngag bden pa g.yung drung bon/ theg chen sdong po dgu 'dus don/ mi nub rgyal mtshan 'dzug pa yis/ rmad du byung ba'i bkra shis shog nam mkhas khyab pa'i sems can dang / khams gsum sems can don du bsngo/ bkra shis par shog/
